facts.text: Under the DePauw Promise, families earning up to $100,000 receive full tuition coverage, while families with incomes up to $50,000 have full direct costs covered, including tuition, housing, and meals.

sources.title: The DePauw Promise
sources.quote: Family income up to $50,000* Full direct costs covered, including tuition, housing, meals and required fees. Family income up to $100,000* Full tuition covered.
